ROUNDUSK basically needs money to be traceable

Every fee has its own bucket: 30% vault, 50% creators, 10% treasury, 10% buybacks

When a trade closes, subtract all costs first, then split the actual profit 50/50 between creators and buybacks

For shared vaults, the accounting has to be crystal clear so no double claims, no double spending, no funny business

Details on: https://roundusk.com/docs

Marko.xbt 🔥 (1.2K) 🗓41m 👁️31
This is the best use of agent modeling I have seen in a while

Dev is followed by alon and founder of a16z

He built an agent that does all your live activities, your daily routine and tasks.

A decision layer that sits in front of the model queue so not every task hits the expensive model.The setup is a 24/7 agent, a few humans, and webhooks generating work all day. Without a gate, every task goes straight to the frontier model. The controller sits one layer above the models and runs each task through a short pipeline that scores whether the answer is worth anything checks whether the information is actually new picks the cheapest model tier that still passes the evaluation and decides if it can wait for a batch.

• Flags anything irreversible
• Routes it, or drops it
• A ping handles the decision; a model never does.

We are getting him onboard. He will be in the community soon
